title: return-workflow
blurb: A returns service accepts impossible lifecycle jumps and records rejected actions. Make its state machine explicit and atomic.
brief:
This service tracks merchandise returns from request through warehouse inspection and refund. Most happy-path operations work, but invalid transitions are accepted and rejected actions can corrupt the audit trail.

Read the tests as the lifecycle specification, then repair `returns/service.py`. Keep the public API and exception types unchanged.

**Your job:** enforce every legal branch and terminal state, and make rejected operations atomic no-ops.
